headline: Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express Timetable
summary: Details regarding the schedule for the upcoming Vande Bharat Express connecting Bengaluru, Mangaluru, and Goa have been released. The scenic journey through the Western Ghats will take approximately 13 hours.

headline: New Vande Bharat Route Replaces Older Service
summary: A new Vande Bharat train connecting Bengaluru to Goa via Mangaluru is set to launch, offering a 13-hour journey. Concurrently, the existing Madgaon-Mangaluru service has been discontinued.

headline: Scenic Vande Bharat Route Between Bengaluru and Goa
summary: Passengers can soon travel between Bengaluru and Goa on a new Vande Bharat Express route winding through the Western Ghats. The journey is expected to take around 13 hours.

headline: Goa Police Inspector Accused of Assaulting Minor
summary: A Goa police inspector and an associate have had an FIR registered against them for allegedly sexually assaulting a minor girl multiple times inside a Crime Branch office after she was called in regarding a cyber complaint.

headline: FIR Filed Against Crime Branch PI in Assault Case
summary: An FIR has been lodged against a Crime Branch police inspector and a woman following allegations that a minor girl was sexually assaulted multiple times at a police facility.

headline: Teen Sexually Assaulted at Goa Police Station
summary: A police inspector in Goa is facing legal and departmental action after being accused of repeatedly assaulting a teenager at a police station under the pretext of a cyber complaint.

headline: Massive Fire Destroys Vasco Sunday Market
summary: A major fire broke out in Vasco's Sunday Market ahead of Diwali, damaging roughly 150 shops and a car accessories store. The Chief Minister has pledged support to those affected.

headline: Vasco Market Fire Destroys Over 150 Shops
summary: A devastating pre-Diwali fire tore through Vasco's Sunday Market, gutting more than 150 shops. Goa's Chief Minister has assured assistance to the affected vendors.

headline: Major Blaze Guts Vasco Market Ahead of Diwali
summary: A fire ravaged over 100 shops in Goa's Vasco Sunday Market just before Diwali. Authorities responded to the blaze, and the Chief Minister has promised support for the victims.

headline: AAIB Cites Crew Error in Goa Runway Incursion
summary: The Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau has attributed a runway incursion incident in Goa to crew error and miscommunication by Air India Express personnel who failed to follow air traffic control instructions.

headline: Renovated Goa Niwas Opens in Delhi
summary: The newly renovated Goa Niwas has been officially inaugurated in New Delhi, offering updated rooms priced at Rs 2,000 per night. It aims to provide comfortable accommodation for visitors from the state.

headline: Chief Minister Pledges Support After Vasco Fire
summary: Following a major fire that destroyed numerous shops in Vasco's Sunday Market, the Goa Chief Minister assured affected business owners of government support.

headline: Bengaluru Couple Relocates to Goa
summary: A couple from Bengaluru recently documented their relocation to Goa, sharing that spending Rs 75,500 on the move was completely worth the lifestyle change.

headline: Traffic Restrictions Announced for Ironman Event
summary: Goa authorities have announced traffic restrictions across various parts of the state on November 1 to facilitate the smooth conduct of the Ironman event.

summary: FC Goa managed to snatch a hard-fought point in a match thanks to a crucial contribution by Vallejo during stoppage time.

summary: As FC Goa travels to Pune to face their next opponents, opposing teams are working on tactical and defensive resets.
